verdict.rationale: Reducto's pricing page lists EU/AU data residency endpoints. Its enterprise docs offer a choice of dedicated VPC, hybrid VPC (all data and storage reside in the customer's VPC) or hosted SaaS, plus air-gapped options, so customers can control where data lives. missing for 10: detailed docs on how to select or configure the EU/AU residency endpoints, a full list of available regions and which plans include them, independent or hands-on confirmation of the residency options.
